2121. Finding the Largest of N Numbers Entered by the User

70

Hard

Problem Statement
Read a count N followed by N integers, and print the largest value among them, using a loop combined with an if statement.

Description
Read an integer N specifying how many values will follow. Read the first value and store it as the current largest. Use a for loop to read each of the remaining N - 1 values one at a time, and inside the loop use an if statement to update the largest value whenever a bigger number is read. After the loop ends, print the largest value found.
input_spec: An integer N, followed by N integers, all separated by spaces.
output_spec: Print the largest of the N numbers.
